shortDescription: 10-week six-day push, pull, legs program with a separate core session.
descriptionHtml: Six push/pull/legs sessions plus a separate core accessory session. The Abs section is accessory work, not a required seventh consecutive training day. Attach it to a suitable session or schedule it separately with recovery in mind.
